title: Young Women Playing Leapfrog in Field, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A playful 1920s outdoor snapshot capturing a group of seven young women playing a game of leapfrog across an open grassy field. The women are styled in popular Roaring Twenties fashions, showcasing bobbed haircuts, white blouses, bloomers, and skirts. The image reflects the spirit of youth culture, female camaraderie, and outdoor recreation in early 20th-century rural America.
